question: Can support labels, cached embeddings, declared input contracts and measured costs select A0 reuse, A1 head adaptation, A3 encoder adaptation plus re-embedding, or REQUEST_MORE_LABELS without using target-query labels?
not_the_old_router: This is a region/support-set policy justified by observed A0/A1 crossover and harmful adaptation in MS-99. It is not the failed label-free block router or P2/P4 prediction fusion.

actions.A0_REUSE: source cache plus source decoder unchanged
actions.A1_HEAD_ADAPT: existing cache retained; decoder adapted on support
actions.A3_REEMBED: OlmoEarth encoder adapted on support, then target data re-embedded; unavailable until the A3 ceiling is measured
actions.REQUEST_MORE_LABELS: fail closed when support cannot justify an update

utility_contract: The policy receives the deployment objective. It must not infer one universal winner across FP-matched IoU and AP, because Solar MS-99 exhibits metric-dependent A0/A1 preference.
forbidden_inputs: query empty-tile labels used to set FP-matched thresholds
test-region action outcomes during policy fitting

C0_deterministic_policy.rule0: if positive_tile_count == 0, do not adapt; choose A0_REUSE or REQUEST_MORE_LABELS
C0_deterministic_policy.rule1: otherwise allow A1 only if tile-level leave-one-out support gain has a one-sided lower confidence bound above zero under the declared deployment utility
C0_deterministic_policy.rule2: if the interval is inconclusive, REQUEST_MORE_LABELS rather than forcing A1
C0_deterministic_policy.note: positive support is necessary for this first policy, not assumed sufficient

A3_ceiling.primary: OlmoEarth official LayerDecayAdamW encoder plus decoder adaptation
A3_ceiling.sensitivity: attention q/v LoRA rank 8; generic PEFT comparator, not novelty
A3_ceiling.development: Sen12 china and chimanimani plus Task-2 folds 0 and 1, K=20, three seeds

outcomes.A1_wins: cache-compatible post-training is sufficient at K=20 in the development scope
outcomes.A3_small_gain: report an accuracy-cost frontier; no blanket re-embedding
outcomes.A3_large_gain: shift the paper toward identifying cache-validity boundaries

development_data: existing Sen12 8-region and Solar 8-fold support draws; all results are exposed and may only be used for feature/rule development
untouched_evaluation: independent Task-3 or Korea sealed target, opened once after policy and deployment thresholds are frozen
baselines: oracle action using query labels for evaluation only

metrics.primary: action regret = oracle query utility minus selected-action query utility
metrics.safety: harmful adaptation rate where selected A1 is at least 0.01 worse than A0
metrics.cost: total label, raw-I/O, GPU and cache-invalidation cost

promotion_gate.regret: at least 30% lower than the best fixed action
promotion_gate.external: same direction on the untouched task or Korea target
promotion_gate.failure: retain deterministic guardrails only; do not build a learned MoE/router

label_free_placebo.minimum_evidence: at least 20-30 label-independent historical windows plus independent event labels
